jcr:content.jcr:title: Patagonia Crossing

hero-mount.headline: Patagonia
hero-mount.subheadline: Two weeks across the granite spires, blue glaciers and wind-scoured steppe of the southern Andes.

text_intro.text:
The end of the world — on foot

Our Patagonia Crossing links the classic "W" of Torres del Paine with Argentina's Fitz Roy massif in a single two-week trek. Glacier-blue lakes, condors overhead, and nights in warm mountain refugios after days of big open country.

image_primary.alt: Trekkers beneath granite spires in Patagonia

text_body.text:
Expedition stages

  • Punta Arenas arrival & logistics day, briefing with local guides.
  • The full "W" circuit: French Valley, Grey Glacier, and the Base Torres sunrise.
  • Border crossing into Argentina via El Calafate and the Perito Moreno glacier.
  • El Chaltén: Laguna de los Tres beneath Fitz Roy, and the Cerro Torre viewpoint.

Experience level

Challenging. You should be a regular multi-day trekker comfortable on exposed, windy terrain for 6–8 hours a day. No technical climbing required, but expect variable weather and some steep scree descents.
